title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our city-by-city guide and price comparison
intro: Aucklanders have plenty of options when it comes to gyms, with prices ranging from $10 to $50 per week. However, with so many choices, it can be overwhelming to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb, including their prices and contract terms.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD is home to many gyms, including City Fitness, Jetts, and Anytime Fitness. These gyms offer convenient locations and a range of equipment and classes. Prices start from $15 per week for a basic membership, with premium memberships available from $30 per week.

sections.heading: Gyms in North Shore Auckland
list: Jetts Takapuna: $14.95 per week, no contract
Anytime Fitness Albany: $24.95 per week, 12-month contract
City Fitness Northcote: $19.95 per week, 6-month contract

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: For those who commute to work, a gym with convenient locations and flexible hours is a must. Anytime Fitness and Jetts offer 24/7 access, with multiple locations throughout Auckland. Prices start from $14.95 per week for a basic membership.

sections.heading: Gym Membership Deals in Auckland
sections.body: Many gyms in Auckland offer discounts and promotions for new members. For example, City Fitness is currently offering a 2-week free trial, while Jetts is offering a $0 joining fee. Be sure to check the gym's website or visit in person to find out about current deals.

cta.text: Compare gym prices and find the best deal for you

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: With so many gyms to choose from in Auckland, it's essential to do your research and find the one that best suits your needs and budget. Consider factors such as location, equipment, classes, and contract terms when making your decision. For more information on specific gyms, check out our individual gym guides, such as our Jetts gym review or Anytime Fitness review.
